sn35.20:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– yo bhikkhave, rūpe abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
sn35.20:1.2: yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn35.20:1.8: yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn35.20:2.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave, rūpe nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
sn35.20:2.2: yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn35.20:2.8: yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
